name: source-business-prd
description: Reverse-engineer evidence-backed business knowledge and as-is PRDs across source repositories with optional database observations.

interface.shortDescription: Understand business behavior from source and data
interface.longDescription: Build traceable business knowledge, current-state PRDs and diagrams from one or multiple repositories, keeping product hypotheses distinct from implementation facts.
defaultPrompt: 使用 source-business-prd 分析指定代码仓库，输出业务知识、现状 PRD、必要图表和证据索引。
